name: KiCad Project Manager
description: Edit KiBot project metadata, restore a missing workflow, and select project status.
description_full: A native wxPython IPC companion for KiCad 9. Inspect the active project, edit metadata and authors, restore a missing CI workflow from a local Coprod or KDT template, and select DRAFT/PRELIMINARY/CHECKED. Preview changes before applying, with local backups and conflict detection. Enable the KiCad API in Preferences → Plugins. Linux requires Python pip, venv, and distro-provided wxPython. Rules/stackup presets and KiBot execution controls are planned for later releases.
